data.title: Manus AI: The Era of Autonomous AI Agents
data.content:
# Manus AI: The Era of Autonomous AI Agents
Manus AI represents a significant leap in autonomous agent technology, released in early 2025. It operates as a super-user on a cloud-based Ubuntu Linux environment, allowing it to execute complex tasks by breaking them down into subtasks and running them in loops.

## Key Technical Insights
- **Autonomous Scaffolding**: Uses a multi-agent architecture where sub-agents handle specific tasks (search, code, deploy) under an executive controller.
- **Hardware Access**: Direct terminal and file system access in a sandboxed VM.
- **Protocol Learning**: Demonstrated the ability to read documentation for new tools (like Claude Coder) and apply them without prior training data.
- **High-Effort Mode**: Features an extended Chain of Thought mode for deep reasoning and detailed planning.
- **Public Deployment**: Integrated deployment pipeline (Manus.space) for one-click publishing of agent-generated assets.

## AI Progress Timeline
- **March 7, 2025**: General release of Manus AI, marking the entry into the era of fully autonomous agents.
